concept: Transit Gateway: hub-and-spoke for many VPCs and on-premises
tests: Choosing a service to connect many VPCs to each other and to on-premises without a full mesh.
expected: AWS Transit Gateway — a central hub with transitive routing, one attachment per VPC, on-prem via VPN/Direct Connect. Triggers: "12 VPCs all communicate", "on-premises", "avoid full mesh".
why_not: Full-mesh VPC peering means 66 connections and peering is non-transitive; an IGW does not connect VPCs; separate VPNs per VPC do not solve VPC-to-VPC and multiply management.
